title: Continuity, Events, Advancement, Life/Ecology Change & Resolution Management

selection_trigger.reconciliation: MNCS-01 through MNCS-18 already completed_verified; MNCS-20 is the next unfinished tranche in reduced strict order.

objective: Implement continuity, Events, advancement, life/ecology change and resolution management for NPC/creature definitions and campaign-scoped instances while preserving canonical identity, authoritative Event history, owner-domain mechanics and progressive-resolution boundaries.
boundaries: MNCS-20 owns NPC/creature continuity and change orchestration only; canonical identity, Event history, mechanics, equipment, relationships, world/environment and live-state owner domains remain authoritative.
Progressive resolution may add or retire active detail but may not replace identity or erase authoritative Event history.
Life/ecology change must reference owner-domain evidence and remain explicit when unresolved.
Historical MNCS-09 continuity projections remain owner-absorbed and may be consumed as projections rather than recreated as a second ledger.
MNCS-22+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
ui-implementation and player-species lanes remain independently governed.
next_action: MNCS-20 remains completed_verified as originally published in PR 592. PR 616 is retained only as a validated post-completion identity/Event-history hardening amendment; it did not reopen the MNCS tranche. MNCS remains terminal through MNCS-24.
